ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a rectangular sequential-logic block. On the left side there are three inputs labeled S, CP, and R; inside the block these correspond to markings like 1S, C1, and 1R. On the right side there is an output labeled Q and another output indicated as the complementary output. Reasoning: S and R are the set and reset inputs of an RS flip-flop. The CP input is a clock-pulse input, meaning the set/reset action is controlled or synchronized by the clock. Therefore, the figure represents a synchronous RS flip-flop.
